Subject: Project Cedar: LP portfolio sale, indicative bids due 13 November 2026

Dear all,

Harbourline Partners is pleased to introduce Project Cedar, the sale of a portfolio of 12 fund interests by a North American public pension (the Seller).

Reference date: 30 June 2026.
Total NAV: approx. USD 330M. Total unfunded: approx. USD 49M.
Pricing guidance: high 80s % of NAV.
Indicative bids due: 13 November 2026.

Portfolio summary (fund names withheld until NDA):
Fund 1: North American mid-market buyout, 2014, commitment $119M, 96% called, DPI 1.93x, TVPI 2.37x, value $50.0M
Fund 2: Western European growth equity, 2019, commitment €37M, 97% called, DPI 0.31x, TVPI 2.06x, NAV €62.8M
Fund 3 ("...ttering Capital"): US large-cap buyout, 2016, commitment $78M, 99% funded, DPI 0.99x, TVPI 1.38x, value $29.9M, unfunded $1.1M

Fund 5: Western European venture capital, 2019, commitment €15.5M, 80% called, DPI 0.33x, TVPI 2.39x, NAV €25.6M, unfunded €3.1M
Fund 6: European direct lending, 2023, commitment €51.5M, 85% called, DPI 0.3x, TVPI 1.0x, NAV €31.6M, unfunded €7.2M

Fund 8: North American venture capital, 2024, commitment $33M, 58% called, DPI 0.0x, TVPI 1.14x, NAV $22.0M
